note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for the Arkansas 2025 Regular Session (LegiScan 2162). Seats come from LegiScan's `district` field, which agrees with Arkansas's own roster here — the district, never the `role` field, decides which chamber a member sits in. Mapped entries are the proposer's 91 matches, five of which are sitting House members running for a Senate seat (each checked for a party match and for other candidates now holding the House seat), plus five hand-added members the proposer cannot reach. Every unmapped entry carries the reason it is null. Three committee sponsor pseudo-people (Joint Budget Committee, House Management, Senate Efficiency — blank district, committee_sponsor 1) are excluded; Maryland's people file carried the same rows.
